name: S5-nano

lineage.how_derived: continued pretraining followed by post-training, with Think and Instruct modes

purpose: Brazilian-Portuguese improvements over Qwen3.5-4B while keeping function calling, tool use and structured outputs (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE read (Apache License 2.0); base Qwen3.5-4B is Apache-2.0.

architecture.kind: Qwen3.5 4B hybrid (linear plus full attention) vision-language model

benchmarks.name: Observatorio Maritaca averages Native BR / Translated PT / Non-native / Total (23 benchmarks)

strengths: +11 points on native Brazilian benchmarks over its base in Think mode
weaknesses: no gain on translated Portuguese (86.94 vs 87.61) or non-native tasks
evaluated on text tasks only; vision not evaluated
best_for: Brazilian Portuguese assistants on small hardware

tona_fit.reason: A regional language tune of Qwen3.5-4B; German users gain nothing, and the base models are already in the database. Offer only if Tona adds a Brazilian-Portuguese class.
